label: rem:algebraic-filter
title: The algebraic filter
html:
Let \alpha be a harmonic 1-form in the basis of q-harmonic basis on branes. Its signature is determined by its commutator with the curvature F_A (substrate parameter).

  1. Fermionic type (matter). [F_A, \alpha] \neq 0. These forms are entangled with the curvature. They see the \mathrm{SO}(3) holonomy and the index -6 fixed points, yielding geodesics trapped or spiralling around the three fundamental vortex filaments.
  2. Bosonic type (radiation). [F_A, \alpha] = 0. These forms commute with the curvature. As longitudinal modes (weight space decomposition), they flow through the bulk undeflected by monodromy fixed points, yielding straight geodesics relative to the gauge-fluid flow.
